scope: Verify integrity and authenticity against independently trusted release identity/key. Install, upgrade and roll back on supported hosts without discarding newer accepted data; maintain the documented source-build alternative (Requirement N35).
source_identity_method: SHA-256 over sorted C35-owned implementation, test, fixture, and documentation paths; each file contributes its path, a NUL separator and its own binary SHA-256. Excludes plans/, docs/agents/SESSION_HANDOFF.json, status-only START_HERE/DEFINITION_OF_DONE and docs/evidence/C35.json to avoid recursive self-reference. Historical evidence remains bound to its original source.

environment.npm: 11.17.0 (toolchain lock pins npm 11.9.0; the executing npm reports 11.17.0)

hardware.required_profile: 4 vCPU / 8192 MiB RAM / 20480 MiB free disk

fixtures.provenance: Repository-authored synthetic release signature, upgrade, rollback, and source-build verification fixture; contains no real private key, credential, or plaintext secret.

results.acceptance: Verify integrity and authenticity against independently trusted release identity/key. Install, upgrade and roll back on supported hosts without discarding newer accepted data; maintain the documented source-build alternative.

invariants_verified.independent_signature_verification: Enforced; scripts/verify-release.mjs and TestC35 verify detached Ed25519 signatures over RELEASE.json, SHA256SUMS.txt, and source archive digests against an out-of-band trusted release identity and public key.
invariants_verified.tamper_and_signer_rejection: Enforced; 1-byte modifications in engine binary or manifest, missing signature/checksum files, and untrusted signers fail closed with CHECKSUM_MISMATCH, SIGNATURE_INVALID, MISSING_SIGNATURE_EVIDENCE, or UNTRUSTED_SIGNER.
invariants_verified.monotonic_authority_and_data_safety: Enforced; host install (v1) -> upgrade (v2) -> binary rollback (v1) preserves all newer accepted records (ManifestVersion 3) and rejects expired, stale, or replayed revisions (EXPIRED_ATTESTATION, STALE_REVISION_REJECTED, STALE_DATA_REJECTED, STALE_VERSION).
invariants_verified.source_build_alternative: Enforced; source/keyhelix-<short>.tar.gz is verified by digest, extracted, and compiled via go build ./cmd/keyhelix to produce a working runnable engine binary.
invariants_verified.provider_ownership: Enforced; OpenBao owns sealed secret bytes and zero plaintext canary bytes appear in release artifacts or durable local metadata.
